title: APOPTOSIS × IIT4-Φ — does pruning the lowest-Φ cell raise survivor mean per-cell Φ?
engine_reused: stdlib/consciousness/iit4_complex.hexa (subsystem_tpm + big_phi chain — REUSED, not reinvented)
per_cell_phi_measure: LOO big-Φ drop: phi_cell(i;S) = bigPhi(S) − bigPhi(S\{i}); subsystem big-Φ via background-conditioning external units to sys_state (IIT 4.0 convention)
apoptosis_rule: remove argMIN phi_cell from the full system; survivor = remaining (n−1) cells
hypothesis_H1: removing the lowest-Φ cell raises survivor mean per-cell Φ (selection-for-integration)
falsifier: Δ_apoptosis ≤ 0 (does NOT raise) across the panel — OR Δ_apoptosis ≤ Δ_control_hi — ⇒ H1 FALSIFIED
finding: Removing the lowest per-cell-Φ cell RAISES survivor mean per-cell Φ in only 3/10 panel substrates (eca22, eca105, eca90_n3). In 7/10 it DECREASES survivor mean per-cell Φ. The primary H1 claim (apoptosis of low-integration cells purifies survivor integration) is contradicted by the majority of the panel. The secondary/weaker claim (apoptosis beats removing the HIGHEST-Φ cell) holds 8/10 — removing the most-integrated cell is worse — but that is NOT the claim under test. Mechanistically, excising any cell shrinks the subsystem and generically lowers the per-cell LOO contribution (fewer co-integrated partners), so 'prune the weakest to strengthen the rest' does not hold for IIT 4.0 big-Φ on these substrates.
verdict_basis: DERIVED from measured numbers: raises=true in only 3/10 panels (majority 7/10 fail). Falsifier 'pruning lowest-Φ does NOT increase survivor mean-Φ across the panel' is met. This is a real independent computation that COULD have supported H1 (3 panels did) — it is not a tautology.
honest_tier: 🔴 FALSIFIED-NUMERICAL. Per-cell Φ = LOO big-Φ drop (a real integration measure, but one of several defensible per-cell Φ definitions; singleton-distinction φ_d is identically 0 for ECA so could not be used). Subsystem big-Φ uses IIT 4.0 background-conditioning (external units pinned to sys_state — documented modeling choice). Panel = 10 ECA substrates n∈{3,4}, fixed sys_state. A broader sys_state sweep / alternative per-cell Φ metric could shift the pass fraction but cannot rescue a 3/10 primary-claim rate to SUPPORTED.
